instruction: In Thunderbird, create a filter that moves all future emails received from no-reply@microsoft.com to your local Bills folder.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a message filter to move all emails from no-reply@microsoft.com to the Bills folder. The evaluator checks the msgFilterRules.dat file for a filter with enabled='yes', action='Move to folder', actionValue pointing to the Bills folder, and condition checking sender email. Uses existing check_thunderbird_filter metric function.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator verifies all instruction requirements - filter enabled, sender condition (from=no-reply@microsoft.com), move action, Bills folder destination, and local folder level
Correct state extraction: Getter reads the canonical Thunderbird filter configuration file (msgFilterRules.dat) which contains all filter definitions
Proper verification logic: Metric correctly parses Thunderbird filter file format and uses _match_record to verify all expected fields (enabled, action, actionValue, condition)
Appropriate postconfig: Closes Message Filters window before evaluation to ensure filter configuration is saved to disk
Robust error handling: Metric correctly handles None case when file doesn't exist (returns 0.0)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Static type checker warns about type mismatch (get_vm_file returns Union but metric expects str), however in practice this works correctly because config has multi=false (default), so get_vm_file returns single str/None, not List. The metric handles None correctly at line 90-91.

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_filter first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
